question: Select the synonym of **Obsequious**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Submissive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obsequious"** refers to someone who is overly eager to please or obey authority, often in a servile or fawning manner. (चापलूस)

 
 
• **Example:** The employee's obsequious behavior towards his boss made his colleagues uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **"Submissive"** means willing to conform to the authority or will of others; behaving in a meek or obedient manner. (आज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** The dog was submissive, obeying every command given by its owner.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Obsequious"** is **"Submissive."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Defiant** (उग्र): Showing resistance or bold disobedience.

 
 
• **Example:** The defiant teenager refused to follow the school rules.
 
 
 
• **Aggressive** (आक्रामक): Ready to attack or confront; forceful and energetic.
 
 
• **Example:** His aggressive approach in the debate startled his opponent.
 
 
 
• **Proud** (गर्वित): Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of achievements or qualities.
 
 
• **Example:** She was proud of her son's accomplishments.
